t2456.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Sufyān ibn Wakīʿ al-Ruʾāsī al-Kūfī as truthful, but his paper-seller inserted into his material what was not his hadith; advised, he did not accept, so his hadith fell away; of the tenth generation.
as: كان صدوقا إلا أنه ابتلي بوراقه فأدخل عليه ما ليس من حديثه فنصح فلم يقبل فسقط حديثه
He was truthful, except that he was afflicted through his paper-seller, who inserted into his material what was not of his hadith; he was advised but did not accept, so his hadith fell away.
They criticise him for things he was prompted with (and accepted).
Abū Zurʿah al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
One should not bother with him.
Abū Zurʿah al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
قيل له: كان يتهم بالكذب؟ قال: نعم
Asked whether he was accused of lying, he said yes.
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
He has a scribe who corrupted his hadith.
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
فما فعل شيئا مما قاله فبطل الشيخ، وكان يحدث بتلك الأحاديث التي قد أدخلت بين حديثه، وقد سرق من حديث المحدثين
He did none of what he said he would do and lost standing, continuing to transmit the material that was inserted among his hadiths. Material had been stolen from the hadiths of other transmitters.

t3499.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr ibn al-ʿĀṣ al-Sahmī, Abū Muḥammad (or Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān), one of the early Companions who narrated many hadiths and one of the ʿAbādila jurists. He died in Dhū al-Ḥijja during the nights of al-Ḥarra, most correctly at al-Ṭāʾif.
as: وكان غزير العلم، مجتهدا في العبادة
He had abundant knowledge and strove hard in worship.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by al-Mizzī
The Prophet said of him, his father and mother: what an excellent household.
ما كان أحد أكثر حديثا عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم مني إلا عبد الله بن عمرو، فإنه كان يكتب
No one had more hadith from the Prophet than me except ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr, for he used to write.
أبو هريرة, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
ما أجد من أصحاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أكثر حديثا مني إلا ما كان من عبد الله بن عمرو، فإنه كان يكتب
I find none of the Prophet's Companions with more hadith than me except ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr, for he used to write.
He was virtuous, a retainer of hadith and learned.
أبو هريرة, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
ما كان أحد أحفظ لحديث رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم مني إلا عبد الله بن عمرو
No one preserved the Prophet's hadith better than me except ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr, for he wrote while I did not.
وكان فاضلا عالما قرأ القرآن والكتب المتقدمة
He was virtuous and learned, and read the Qurʾān and the earlier scriptures.
أبو هريرة, quoted by Ibn al-Athīr
ما كان أحد أحفظ لحديث رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم مني إلا عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص، فإنه كان يكتب ولا أكتب
No one preserved the Prophet's hadith better than me except ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr, for he wrote and I did not.
كعب الأحبار, quoted by Ibn Saʿd
You are the most learned in religion among the Arabs.
